dct_description_sm: Concurrent monitoring over multiple years of several biotic and abiotic factors is required to characterize the breeding ecology (survival, breeding abundance, productivity, recruitment) of Arctic-breeding raptors. The four main objectives are: Objective 1: Estimate direct density independent mortality, Objective 2: Estimate Indirect density independent mortality, Objective 3: Condition dependent reproductive delay in females, Objective 4: Density dependent response in birth rate.
dct_title_s: Multi-scale investigation of the population ecology of raptors in Nunavut
